fee_notes: Single territory fee is $49,000. Multi-territory discounts apply: 2 territories=$90,650 cumulative, 3=$129,850, 4=$166,600, 5=$203,350. Veterans receive 20% discount on first territory. One franchisee paid $50,000 discounted fee for four territories in fiscal year ending Dec 31, 2025.
raw_excerpt: The Initial Franchise Fee is $49,000 for a geographic area that operates as a single territory with a population of approximately 250,000 people
